articles.summary: About 250 union watchmen at the ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach could strike as early as 5 p.m. Pacific today, November 4, when their contract extension runs out.
articles.title: Potential Strike: 250 Port Watchmen Could Stall LA and Long Beach
